body.raw:
{
  "meteorologueId": 2,
  "zone": "POS-01",
  "typeRisque": "CANICULE",

  "texte": "Vigilance orange canicule : plus de 42 degres attendus.",
  "valideDe": "{{debut}}",
  "valideJusqua": "{{fin}}"

exec: pm.test("niveau ORANGE ou ROUGE, indice >= 60", function () { pm.expect(["ORANGE","ROUGE"]).to.include(j.niveau); pm.expect(j.indice).to.be.at.least(60); });
